text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 spike detected (2.6s) on v4.0.2; threshold 1.9s. Recommend auto-rollback for non-pinned routes to v4.0.1 in 3m. To stop: /deploy override hold --by=<user>. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/canary/p95
Mina: Do NOT rollback yet. We have a performance test scheduled with a pilot tenant running on this canary. Hold auto action and investigate root cause first.
Carlos: Agree with Mina. Quick checks: any 5xxs? any infra alerts?
Devon: No 5xx spike. I see increased queue latency and KV cache churn on gpu-4. Also node gpu-4-12 had a maintenance eviction 7m ago. Could be noise.
ops-runner: I can apply a temporary hold for 15m, and pin pilot-pool to v4.0.2. Then we can run a targeted rollback for public-hosted (non-pilot) if needed.
Mina: Hold and pin please. Also create a staged rollback job but don't execute unless telemetry stays bad after tests.
deploy-bot: Manual hold applied by Mina (15m). Pin task queued: pool=pilot-pool -> v4.0.2. Staged rollback job created: target=hosted-public -> v4.0.1, wait-for=manual-confirm. id: rb-staged-7743210000
Carlos: Running perf harness now against canary with 20 concurrent workers. Sharing summary in 5m.
Devon: Ops: if we rollback hosted-public, please ensure release-notes callout and support flagged. I can draft a 1-line message for pilots.
release-coordinator: Drafted: "We are initiating a targeted rollback for public-hosted traffic to mitigate a latency regression observed in canary. Pilot tenants remain on the canary for ongoing investigation." Posting to #release-notes after rollback starts.
Carlos: Perf run done: spikes correlate tightly with gpu-4 KV misses. P95 still elevated. Recommend proceeding with targeted rollback for hosted-public.
Mina: Confirmed. Ops-runner, execute staged rollback (rb-staged-7743210000). Keep waves small (25% every 5m).
ops-runner: Starting wave 1 (25%) now. run-id rb-staged-7743210000-w1. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 complete. Public-hosted p95 reduced by ~0.6s, no 5xxs. Proceed when ready.
Mina: Proceed wave 2. Notify support and post release-note blurb.
release-coordinator: Published release note and pinged support rotation. Support playbook attached in #support.
ops-runner: Wave 2/4 complete. Rolling remaining waves. All done. Rollback successful. Releasing manual hold.
Devon: Follow-up: schedule immediate RCA and add a test for KV churn scenario in perf suite.
Mina: Thanks all. Closing thread once RCA invite sent.
